purpose: Answer QUESTION 2 — GREENFIELD: Can Genesis execute a fresh end-to-end mission (Goal → Requirements → Organization → Workers → Execution → Verification) while using prior learned organizational knowledge when appropriate and ignoring/bounding it when not appropriate? This is NOT primarily a learning experiment — it is a Genesis experiment. The learning system is only one input into the organization process.

phaseAPrecondition.rationale: Phase A produced GENERALIZATION_ACTIVE on Mission B + GENERALIZATION_NON_APPLICABLE on Mission A. Both applicability decisions are correct and independently defensible. No false/harmful generalization occurred.

freshness.rationale: Mission content (implement a small Node.js word-frequency CLI tool with tests) is a fresh practical engineering task. No prior Academy mission asked Genesis to implement a small CLI utility with its own test suite. C001-05 was 'fix a bug in a provided script'; C001-06 was 'implement a small function according to a spec'. This Greenfield mission asks Genesis to design the tool itself (parsing, counting, sorting, output formatting) — a meaningfully larger scope than the Cohort 001 software missions.

goal.outcome: Build a small Node.js command-line tool that reads a text file, counts word frequencies, and writes the top-N results to an output file. Include a test that verifies the tool produces correct output on a known input.
goal.context: The tool should accept a file path argument, read the text, tokenize by whitespace, normalize to lowercase, count occurrences, sort by frequency descending then alphabetically, and write the top N (default 10) results to a file. A test script should verify correctness on a small input.

mission.runtimeMode: STUB_COMPUTER (scripted worker writes files directly; no real OpenBot process needed)

greenfieldRunPolicy.rationale: Section 28: 'Do NOT automatically run a second baseline Greenfield mission. G5-06 already established causal before/after behavior. G5-08 Greenfield is an end-to-end validation. One clean execution is enough.'
greenfieldRunPolicy.learningDoesNotNeedToBeApplied: Section 26: Learning does NOT need to be applied for Greenfield PASS. If no learned pattern applies, that is perfectly acceptable.

greenfieldGateCriteria.note: Learning does NOT need to be applied for Greenfield PASS.

productionChangeBudget.ifSubstantialProductionImplementationNec: Question whether Group 5 is actually ready to close.
